scenarios.title: Everyday AI Assistant
scenarios.question: What must keep working for an AI assistant to answer a single question?
scenarios.intro: An AI answer looks instantaneous. Behind it sit physical facilities, human decisions, datasets, governance and environmental demands.
scenarios.focus: Trace the path from a user question back to electricity, infrastructure, people and policy.
